payload.claim: `_resolve_stacked_on`'s docstring still says a row's `pushed_sha` "is written by PACKAGE — or, since `SA-0069`, by a push of unpackaged work when PACKAGE never ran". After this change, `push_unpackaged_work` can also write `pushed_sha` (via `ledger.record_push`, `saffron/phases/package.py:1242`) when `package()` in the new `exhausted` mode *did* run but refused (e.g. a conflict or a gone parent) — so the fallback push is no longer exclusive to "PACKAGE never ran". This exact sentence is listed in the task's own notes as one that goes false and needs updating, and it was not touched by this diff.
